The orcs of Ulderek's Rock are preparing for war and the guard {npc:Baxter}, at the door of Thais castle, needs volunteers. You can repair outposts, set fire to ballistas, catapults and siege towers and spy on the orcs' war plans. Each task gives 1000 experience (2000 at the top rank) and, as you collect "achievements", you rise in rank up to **War Hero**, with an experience bonus at each promotion.
Baxter, at the door of Rain Castle in Thais
up to 44; buy them from Baxter (task 1)
bring more than one: it can blow up in your hands (task 2)
1000 experience for each achievement (2000 after you reach War Hero)
1000 experience for each delivery of the war plans
Promotion bonus: Henchman +2000, Mercenary +3000, Orc Butcher +5000, War Hero +7000 experience
Ask Baxter about {key:war plans} **before** going to the fortress: if he already knows the current plans, the trip is pointless.
Repairing the outposts and burning the equipment can only be done once every 6–7 hours.
To rank up: completing task 2 (burning) **once** or task 1 (repairing) **twice** counts as one achievement.

Go to **Thais** and look for {npc:Baxter}, outside the {wiki:Rain Castle}. Say {key:hello}, {key:mission} and then {key:orc war}. He explains the 3 tasks: establish outposts, burn war equipment and find out the war plans.
Buy up to **44** {item:Bricklayers' Kit|Bricklayers' Kits} from Baxter. Also get at least one {item:Fire Bug} (preferably several).
You have to repair 4 outposts and 2 walls. It can only be done once every 6–7 hours.

Go to the wyvern nest at {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, outside the {wiki:Orc Fortress}. Ferngrims Gate is **northwest of Venore**, southeast of Ab'Dendriel and east of Kazordoon; the {wiki:Ulderek's Rock|Orc Fortress} is just to the **east**. From Thais, take the boat to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Bluebear}) and walk **northwest**.
Location of the walls and outposts

Use a {item:Bricklayers' Kit} on each broken {item:Brick Wall} until it is repaired. It is complete when an **orange warning** appears and the orcs start to spawn. Repeat on the 4 outposts and the 2 walls.
Orcs attacking the outpost after the repair
You do not need to kill the orcs: as soon as you see the orange warning you can move on to the next spot. If nobody kills them, they disappear after 10 minutes.
After each repair, orcs appear in waves, every 30 seconds for 5 minutes. They can drop {item:Orc Tusk|Orc Tusks}.
There are dozens of {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}. Move away right after the warning if you do not want to fight.

Go back to {npc:Baxter} and say {key:achievement}. Remember: the repair has to be done **twice** to count as a rank achievement. To go back, move away from the orc waves, walk back to Venore and take the boat to **Thais** ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
You have to set fire to 8 {item:Ballista|Ballistae}, 8 {item:Catapult|Catapults} and 2 {item:Siege Tower|Siege Towers}. It can only be done once every 6–7 hours.
Go to the ballista area and use the {item:Fire Bug} on **all 8** {item:Ballista|Ballistae}.
Go to the catapult area and use the {item:Fire Bug} on the **8** {item:Catapult|Catapults}.
Go **south** of the {wiki:Orc Fortress}, to the {item:Siege Tower|Siege Towers}. Set fire to **all the wheels** (3 on each tower).
The Fire Bug can blow up in your hands. Bring more than one.
Go back to {npc:Baxter} and say {key:achievement}. The way back is the same as in task 1: on foot to Venore and by boat to Thais.
1000 experience (2000 if you are already War Hero)
Available after you have done the other two tasks. It can be repeated as many times as you like, every few days, independently of the others.
Say {key:war plans} to {npc:Baxter}. If he says he already knows the current plan, come back in a few days.

Go to the {wiki:Orc Fortress} and go down **1 floor**. The plans are on the **north** wall. Use them: orange text appears telling you to go back to Baxter. The fortress is **northwest of Venore** (see task 1). After reading the plans, go up the same stairs and leave the fortress the way you came in.
The war plans on the wall
Go back to {npc:Baxter} and say {key:war plans}.
After this Baxter says *"We already know their current plan! Come back in a few days."* until the orcs change their plan.
Say {key:achievement} to {npc:Baxter} regularly. As you collect achievements you get promoted and receive extra experience.
+7000 exp; from then on 2000 exp (instead of 1000) per achievement
Baxter also pays 1 gold for each freshly killed rat you bring him (Thais sewers mission).
